EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hey there! You seem a bit tired.
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Playing too much isn't good for you,
got it? Why don't you take a short
break?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}¡Hola! Te veo algo cansad{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}},
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Jugar muchas horas seguidas
tampoco es bueno, ¿eh? ¿Por
qué no descansas un poco?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Dis donc ! Tu m'as l'air sur les
rotules,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Jouer, c'est comme s'entraîner :
sans pauses régulières, tu te fais
plus de mal que de bien !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Ehilà! Mi sembri un po' stanc{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}.
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non ti fa bene giocare troppo
a lungo, capito? Perché non fai
una pausa?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hey ho!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Du siehst müde aus. {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Es tut dir nicht gut,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} wenn du's mit
dem Spielen übertreibst! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Du solltest
dir 'ne kleine Auszeit gönnen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hey! Biraz yorgun görünüyorsun.
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Çok oynamak iyi değildir, tamam mı?
Kısa bir mola versene!

EN:
You know, you've been playing for
a long time now.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} Why don't you take
a quick break?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Resting is important too! Without
proper rest, your muscles won't
grow! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
Oye, ya llevas jugando bastante
tiempo. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Por qué no descansas
un ratito si eso?
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Descansar también es importante!
Si no descansas bien, ¡tus músculos
no se desarrollarán, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}, ça fait un moment
que tu joues, là.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Et si tu faisais une
petite pause ?
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}La récupération, c'est important !
Si tu négliges cette phase, tes
muscles ne se développeront pas !
IT:
Forse non te ne sei accort{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}, ma
stai giocando da troppo tempo.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}
Perché non ti fermi per un po'?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}È importante anche riposarsi!
Altrimenti i muscoli non riescono
a crescere! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
Uzun zamandır oynadığını
biliyorsun.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} Biraz
kısa mola versene?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Dinlenmek de
önemli! İyi dinlenmezsen
kasların büyümez! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Hang on, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}It's time to
take a break now! Playing too much
can make you tired!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Temps mort, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Faut faire
une pause !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Trop jouer n'est pas
gégé pour ta santé, tu sais !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Un attimo, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}È arrivato
il momento di fare una pausa! Se
giochi troppo a lungo ti stancherai!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Dur bakalım, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Şimdi biraz
mola verme zamanı! Çok oynamak
yorar insanı!
